table.name: tags
table.sql: CREATE TABLE "tags" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL, "parent_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE SET NULL)

table.name: tasks
table.sql: CREATE TABLE "tasks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("done" IN (0, 1)), "tag_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL)

table.name: time_entries
table.sql: CREATE TABLE "time_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "tag_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "task_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL)
